THE_RULE_AS_LANDED.Q-DE-328: a later amendment could move a pin ONLY by NAMING the identity it replaced; an unnamed move REFUSED
THE_RULE_AS_LANDED.Q-DE-329: PLAIN VERSION ORDER -- the highest amendment wins and an unnamed move is ADMITTED. This is the ruling as worded. DA's v15/v16/v17 still carry `supersedes` blocks: they are no longer required, they are harmless, and they are kept because they state the intent in the artifact rather than leaving it to be inferred from a sort order.
THE_RULE_AS_LANDED.THE_ONE_REFUSAL_A_VERSION_ORDER_CANNOT_S: a SINGLE document pinning the same key TWICE. Caught with an object_pairs_hook, because JSON would otherwise keep the last silently. Version order settles two amendments; it cannot settle one document disagreeing with itself.
THE_RULE_AS_LANDED.WHAT_THIS_COSTS: a silent overwrite by a later amendment is now possible. That is the price of the ruling and it is recorded here rather than discovered later: the protection against a wrong pin is now the VERSION NUMBER alone.

THE_PIN_IS_A_RULE_NOT_A_COMMIT.RULE: the valuation path is frozen when BOTH hold: (a) HEAD IS A DESCENDANT OF THE BASE COMMIT, and (b) EVERY ONE OF THE SEVEN FROZEN MODULES IS BYTE-IDENTICAL TO THE DIGEST DECLARED HERE. Neither half alone is the freeze.
THE_PIN_IS_A_RULE_NOT_A_COMMIT.WHY_A_RULE: a bare commit made every DECLARATION-ONLY landing look like a freeze move. Between DA 247 and DA 253 the freeze commit was restated FIVE times -- 8afbd1a, d095c5a, 6d22d78, bacb4e3, b34ed9f -- and four of those restatements existed only because the declarations themselves had landed on top. The digests are what the check actually needs; the commit is provenance.
THE_PIN_IS_A_RULE_NOT_A_COMMIT.A_DECLARATION_ONLY_COMMIT_NEVER_MOVES_TH: a commit that touches only live/pm_research/declarations/** changes NO frozen module digest, so it satisfies (b) unchanged and satisfies (a) by being a descendant. It is therefore NOT a freeze move and needs NO new code-freeze version. This is the rule that ends the v3->v4->v5 churn: those three versions differed only because declarations landed.
THE_PIN_IS_A_RULE_NOT_A_COMMIT.WHAT_STILL_MOVES_THE_FREEZE: any change to one of the seven module digests below, and nothing else.
THE_PIN_IS_A_RULE_NOT_A_COMMIT.BASE_IS_PROVENANCE_ONLY: any DESCENDANT of the base is admissible; the base is not required to be HEAD.
THE_PIN_IS_A_RULE_NOT_A_COMMIT.why_digests_may_come_from_a_later_commit: the base records where the freeze began; the digests record what is frozen NOW. When a module legitimately changes, the digest moves and the base does not.

FALSIFIER_B_module_absent_DID_NOT_FIRE.so: VALUATION_CLOSURE_MODULE_ABSENT is unreachable for any declared row that is also IMPORTED.
